# Terminus 6×12

The Pi reference application uses Terminus 6×12 normal BDF glyphs from
version 4.49.1 by Dimitar Toshkov Zhekov. The source and SIL Open Font
License 1.1 were extracted from the upstream release archive at
https://sourceforge.net/projects/terminus-font/files/terminus-font-4.49/
on 2026-09-27.

The source SHA-256 is
`9e942cad8173fddf34fc8a784e9ec6d2d4cfb8b82363faf65f43b236fe2f5a99`.
The license SHA-256 is
`c14f8d795784a547ea35e69c51dee2957bb71a1cdb492ec5321e4b61d3d97630`.
The Pi generator validates both before selecting the SPEC-001 glyph subset.
